native.reference: CPython MT plus independent C++ standard MT19937 initialization

native.internal_state_boundary: Owned state comes from this service; internal diagnostics do not admit arbitrary foreign owner bytes.

release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.

pytorch.raw32_reference_boundary: Full CPython MT19937 words plus actual Torch int32 low31 projection and full state. No host RNG in target.
pytorch.nondeterministic_seed_boundary: Native and Torch independently call seed(); target seed is then passed to reference manual_seed for complete state and value comparison.
pytorch.scope: Canonical CPU Generator states and specified uniform/integer draws; no normal target generation, Tensor filling, default global generator, concurrent access or accelerator RNG.
